entry.title: The Motherland Calls

buildingCutout.basis: The single mapped low foundation is occupied by the exact modeled plinth.

entry.note: The mapped plinth fixes the center and axis. A geotagged summit photograph resolves the east-southeast face. The embedded base and short apron follow standard terrain. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
